text:
mira: Quick escalation from customer call  ephemeral keys created via Console are sometimes billed to org instead of selected project. Repro below.
mira: Repro: Console > Test API > Create ephemeral key (project=proj-marketing) > send -> quota increments on org:org-acme.
mira: Trace headers: `Authorization: Bearer ephem-abc123; X-Console-Project=proj-marketing; X-Org=org-acme; X-Creation-Source=console`
mira: Router log (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-20T09:12:04Z] req=req_0x9a3 claims={"token_origin":"ephemeral","project":null,"org":"org-acme"} decision=charge_target=org-acme reason=missing_effective_project
```
tony: Likely token mint path not embedding project claim. Console header might be dropped by proxy for ephemeral flows.
eli: Long-term: mint token with `effective_project` claim after validating membership. Short-term: preserve X-Console-Project in proxy for keygen flows. Prefer A.
billing: If live customers affected we need a detection query + sample request ids to scope credits.
ops-bot: deploy: canary keygen-service v1.5 and router v3.22 scheduled 02:00 UTC. Feature-flag gate: authz:ephemeral-project-claim.
tony: Security note: when embedding project claim, keygen must validate user membership/role for that project. No arbitrary projects.
eli: Implementation plan: 1) keygen validates membership and signs token with `effective_project` claim. 2) router prefers token_claims.effective_project over headers. 3) add telemetry enum `billing_charge_via=token_claim|console_header|sa_owner`. 4) Console confirmation modal "This key will be billed to proj-marketing (org-acme)".
mira: Also add internal debug header `X-Debug-Force-Project` for SRE reproduction.
tony: Ops: expose a canary dashboard for charge_target distribution and add alert: if org billing >0.5% spike, auto-rollback.
billing: Please produce detection query: tokens minted last 7 days with origin=console and missing effective_project. We'll prepare credits if needed.
mira: I'll open PRs for keygen + UX and include tests and traces. ETA 4h. Will post PR links here.
eli: Also add migration runbook and a short support blurb.
opS-bot: reminder: add feature flag `authz:ephemeral-project-claim` and tag #support #billing in rollout ticket.
mira: thanks all :rocket
